title: Plea in Supreme Court challenges Speaker Om Birla's decision to clear Uddhav Sena MPs' merger with Shinde Sena
description: A petition has been filed before the Supreme Court to challenge Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla's decision to recognize the merger of six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs with Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena. The matter was mentioned before a Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice Vipul M Pancholi on Tuesday for urgent listing."This is an important matter.. Speaker recognises the merger of my 6 MPs to merge with the rival party. This shows an important of a constitutiona
